يحتفظوا (form VIII)
# يَحْتَفِظُوا (yaḥtafiẓū) /jaħ.ta.fi.ðˤuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَفَظَ (iḥtafaẓa)
# يُحْتَفَظُوا (yuḥtafaẓū) /juħ.ta.fa.ðˤuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَفَظَ (iḥtafaẓa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
